title: Emergency department: how many doctors?
intro: Patients arrive at random, a nurse triages them, and doctors see them. Urgent patients (one in five) go first and may interrupt a routine consultation; routine patients who wait too long leave without being seen. Each value is the mean of 20 simulated 12-hour days. Choose the number of doctors and the arrival rate, and watch the queue, the waits and the share of patients who leave.
